content:
Located in the UK's The Oracle shopping centre in Reading, the Apple store is set to relocate to a new location in December, featuring a brand new design.

Prior to that, the Apple Festival Place store in Basingstoke will close in November, bringing the total number of Apple retail stores in the UK down to 38…

Apple stated that the renovated Oracle store will offer all the amenities customers expect from a newly designed store.

We are excited to reopen the fully redesigned Apple The Oracle store in December, offering customers in south-east England new ways to explore and shop for the latest Apple products, as well as get support for the devices they own. The new Apple The Oracle will feature experiential rooms for customers to explore products, a dedicated Genius Bar, and an Apple Pick Up area for collecting online orders, along with free Today at Apple sessions to help customers get the most out of their favourite products.

The store originally opened in June 2011. Prior to the reopening, Apple's store in Basingstoke will be the first to close.

As we prepare for these updates, we have decided to close the Apple Festival Place store. Apple Festival Place will remain open until November 2026, after which all staff will have the opportunity to transfer to Apple The Oracle or other Apple Store locations. Over the past 15 years, it has been our great honour to serve the Basingstoke community, and we look forward to continuing to welcome customers at nearby Apple Stores, as well as on Apple.com, the Apple Store app, and at Apple Authorised Resellers and service providers throughout south-east England.

This store has also been operating since 2011.

Over the past 18 months, Apple has renovated its Regent Street store in London as well as its branch at the Lakeside shopping centre in Essex. Stores in Birmingham and Southampton are also undergoing upgrades.

Globally, Apple has opened a total of 11 new stores over the past 18 months and relocated another 17 to new sites featuring the new design, including Apple Miami Worldcenter and Apple Downtown Detroit.
